name: wise-lizard
description: A square brutalist 3D username field: hard offset shadow, warning plaque, and a native text input that lifts on hover.
purpose: Collects a short identity value with a tilted poster frame while keeping a native text control and square corners.
bestFor: sign-in or handle fields that can afford visual weight
onboarding rows that need a labeled username control
avoidFor: quiet enterprise forms that need a low-contrast input
